<h1>You are a worker honeybee.</h1>
<p class="g-lede">You will live <strong>about a month</strong>. Spend it nursing the queen's
brood in safety, or foraging: glorious for the colony, and the job that kills most workers.
Or gamble: sneak your own eggs into the comb, past the <strong>police that eat 98% of
them</strong>. Your genes ride on the colony either way. Spend yourself well.</p>
<div class="g-cta">

<details class="wyd-model">
<summary>How the odds work</summary>
<div class="wyd-model-body">
<p>Every core number is drawn from published studies. You allocate 3 ⚡ stamina a week: nursing
pays the colony +3 safely; foraging pays +5 but adds 12% to that week's death risk per trip; a
laid egg survives worker policing with P = 0.02 (worth +150 if it does). Baseline mortality
rises 2% per week of age; a real summer worker lives about 2–5 weeks. Some weeks the colony's
needs shift — a brood boom doubles what nursing is worth, a nectar flow doubles foraging (the
week-to-week needs are the game's own invention, standing in for the very real way colony
labor demands change). Score = colony points ×6 plus your sons. Full sources and the natural
history live on the <a href="learn-bee.html">Learn&nbsp;more page</a>.</p>
</div>
</details>

<script>window.WYD_SPECIES = "bee";</script>
<script src="assets/js/wyd-core.js"></script>
<script>
/* ── honeybee engine ──
   pass-1 rebalance (full redesign blueprint: ../design/bee-redesign.md):
   each week the colony NEEDS something (brood boom doubles nursing, nectar flow
   doubles foraging) so the optimal allocation shifts week to week; score = colony x6
   + sons x150, so the board has a real gradient. */
const BEE = { pEggSurvive:0.02, sonValue:150, nurseGain:3, forageGain:5,
  forageRisk:0.12, senesc:0.02, stamina:3, colonyPts:6 };
const NEEDS = [
  {key:"brood",  p:0.3, mult:{nurse:2, forage:1},
   label:"Brood boom — the queen has filled the comb; <strong>nursing pays double</strong> this week."},
  {key:"nectar", p:0.3, mult:{nurse:1, forage:2},
   label:"Nectar flow — the fields are blooming; <strong>foraging pays double</strong> this week."},
  {key:"calm",   p:0.4, mult:{nurse:1, forage:1},
   label:"An ordinary week in the colony."}];
function rollNeed(){
  let t = roll();
  for(const n of NEEDS){ t -= n.p; if(t <= 0) return n; }
  return NEEDS[2];
}
let G = null;

function wydStart(){
  $("#wyd-play").style.display = "block";
  $("#wyd-log").innerHTML = "";
  G = {week:0, round:0, score:0, sons:0, colony:0, forages:0, alive:true, cause:"", needKey:"calm"};
  log("You emerge into the hive. The queen is laying; the police are patrolling.");
  weekPhase();
}
function wydHud(){
  const h = $("#wyd-hud"); if(!h || !G) return;
  const pips = [0,1,2].map(k=>`<i class="${k < G.stamina ? "on":""}"></i>`).join("");
  h.innerHTML = `<div class="wyd-ghud">
    <div class="gstat"><span class="gl">Week</span><span class="gv">${G.week}</span></div>
    <div class="gstat"><span class="gl">Stamina ⚡</span><div class="wyd-pips">${pips}</div></div>
    <div class="gstat"><span class="gl">Colony 🍯</span><span class="gv">${G.colony}</span></div>
    <div class="gstat"><span class="gl">Sons</span><span class="gv">${G.sons}</span></div>
    <div class="gstat"><span class="gl">Score</span><span class="gv">${Math.round(G.score)}</span></div>
  </div>`;
}
function ageRisk(){ return Math.min(0.6, BEE.senesc * G.week); }
function weekPhase(){
  G.week++; G.round = G.week;
  G.stamina = BEE.stamina; G.forages = 0;
  G.needKey = rollNeed().key;
  wydSaveRun(G);  // autosave at the start of each week; Exit + Resume pick up here
  renderWeek();
}
function need(){ return NEEDS.find(n=>n.key===G.needKey) || NEEDS[2]; }
function wydResumeRun(g){
  G = g;
  $("#wyd-play").style.display = "block";
  $("#wyd-log").innerHTML = "";
  log(`Resumed at week ${G.week}.`);
  renderWeek();
}
function renderWeek(){
  const risk = 1 - (1 - ageRisk()) * Math.pow(1 - BEE.forageRisk, G.forages);
  const nd = need();
  const nGain = BEE.nurseGain * nd.mult.nurse, fGain = BEE.forageGain * nd.mult.forage;
  scene(`<div class="wyd-round">🍯 Week ${G.week} · plan the week</div>
    <h3><span class="${G.stamina===BEE.stamina ? "wyd-buzzy" : ""}" aria-hidden="true">🐝</span> The colony hums. Where do you spend yourself?</h3>
    <p class="wyd-story">You have <strong>${G.stamina} ⚡ stamina</strong> this week. Nursing is safe.
    Foraging feeds the colony best but kills workers: every trip adds ${fmtP(BEE.forageRisk)} to this
    week's death risk. And the comb is right there, unguarded, if you want to gamble an egg…</p>
    <p class="wyd-story wyd-event">${nd.label}</p>
    <div class="wyd-pacts" style="margin-top:1.2rem">
      <button class="btnx btnx--solid" id="wyd-nurse" ${G.stamina<1?"disabled":""}>Nurse the brood · 1 ⚡ <span class="sub">colony +${nGain}${nd.mult.nurse>1?" (doubled!)":""} · safe</span></button>
      <button class="btnx" id="wyd-forage" ${G.stamina<1?"disabled":""}>Forage · 1 ⚡ <span class="sub">colony +${fGain}${nd.mult.forage>1?" (doubled!)":""} · +${fmtP(BEE.forageRisk)} death risk this week</span></button>
      <button class="btnx wyd-clay" id="wyd-lay" ${G.stamina<1?"disabled":""}>Lay your own egg · 1 ⚡ <span class="sub">${fmtP(BEE.pEggSurvive)} chance it survives the police · +${BEE.sonValue} if it does</span></button>
    </div>
    <div class="wyd-sleeprow"><button class="btnx" id="wyd-endweek">End the week →</button>
    <div class="wyd-sleepwarn">Your death risk this week so far: ${fmtP(risk)} (age ${fmtP(ageRisk())}${G.forages? ` + ${G.forages} foraging trip${G.forages>1?"s":""}`:""}). A real summer worker lives 2–5 weeks.</div></div>`);
  $("#wyd-nurse").onclick = ()=>{ G.stamina--; G.colony += nGain; G.score += nGain * BEE.colonyPts;
    log(`Week ${G.week}: nursed brood. Colony +${nGain}.`, "good"); renderWeek(); };
  $("#wyd-forage").onclick = ()=>{ G.stamina--; G.forages++; G.colony += fGain; G.score += fGain * BEE.colonyPts;
    log(`Week ${G.week}: foraged. Colony +${fGain} (risk +${fmtP(BEE.forageRisk)}).`, "good"); renderWeek(); };
  $("#wyd-lay").onclick = ()=>{ G.stamina--;
    const r = roll(), survived = r < BEE.pEggSurvive;
    if(survived){ G.sons++; G.score += BEE.sonValue; }
    log(`Week ${G.week}: laid an egg. ${survived? "IT SURVIVED (+"+BEE.sonValue+")":"Policed and eaten"} (roll ${r.toFixed(3)} vs ${BEE.pEggSurvive}).`, survived?"good":"bad");
    renderWeek(); };
  $("#wyd-endweek").onclick = endWeek;
  wydHud();
}
function endWeek(){
  const pAge = ageRisk();
  const pDie = 1 - (1 - pAge) * Math.pow(1 - BEE.forageRisk, G.forages);
  if(roll() < pDie){
    G.alive = false;
    G.cause = G.forages && roll() < 0.7 ? "field" : "age";
    log(`Week ${G.week}: died ${G.cause==="field"?"in the field":"of old age"} (P was ${fmtP(pDie)}). ☠`, "bad");
    scene(`<div class="wyd-round">🍯 Week ${G.week}</div>
      <h3>${G.cause==="field" ? "You don't make it home." : "You fall from the comb."}</h3>`+ outcomeBlock(
      `Your death risk this week was <strong>${fmtP(pDie)}</strong> (age ${fmtP(pAge)}${G.forages? " + "+G.forages+" foraging trip"+(G.forages>1?"s":""):""}). This time it caught you.`,
      G.cause==="field"
        ? `A dragonfly, a swallow, a storm, a windshield. Foragers rarely die in bed.`
        : `Workers wear out. The colony you fed flies on without you.`,
      "In real life",
      `Foraging is the deadly job: marked foragers suffer heavy weekly mortality, and summer
       workers live only ~2–5 weeks. A worker's fitness is what she banked in the colony,
       plus any sons the police didn't find.`,
      "Visscher & Dukas 1997 · Winston 1987"));
    $("#wyd-next").onclick = beeEnd;
    return;
  }
  log(`Week ${G.week}: survived (P(die) was ${fmtP(pDie)}).`, "good");
  weekPhase();
}
function beeEnd(){
  const verdict = `You worked ${G.week} week${G.week===1?"":"s"} (a real summer worker lives 2–5),
    banking ${G.colony} colony points (×${BEE.colonyPts})${G.sons? ` and, against 2% odds, fledging ${G.sons}
    son${G.sons>1?"s":""}`:""}. ${G.sons? "Almost no real worker ever pulls that off."
    : "If you laid eggs, the police ate them, as they do to ~98% of worker-laid eggs. The colony was the better bet all along."}`;
  wydEnd({score: G.score, verdict, nights: G.week});
}
</script>
